articles.title: Callina Liang's Stunt Double in the Street Fighter Movie Had to Wear Butt Pads to Match Chun-Li's Physique
articles.summary: Callina Liang’s stunt double in Legendary’s upcoming Street Fighter movie had to wear butt pads in order to realistically match Chun-Li’s muscular physique. Director Kitao Sakurai revealed this humorous anecdote during a Q&A session at a media event ahead of the movie’s official release.
body: In fact, Liang’s silhouette had gotten so muscular that her stunt double couldn’t convincingly pull off her physique for action sequences — so she had to wear butt pads to make her glutes match the results of Chun-Li’s rigorous squat routine.

“I knew it was serious when we were filming a scene kind of later in the movie, and I saw Callina’s stunt double, and I was like, ‘What are you wearing?’ And there were like these butt pads that she had to wear just to match Callina’s physique,” Sakurai said.
Noah Centineo, who plays Ken Masters, chimed in: “Yeah, and then we had to wear them out of solidarity, too.”
Liang has been open about the work it took to bring Chun-Li to life, saying she took on a grueling martial arts routine and even ate a dozen eggs every single day to gain enough muscle mass.
points: Callina Liang’s stunt double in Legendary’s upcoming Street Fighter movie had to wear butt pads in order to realistically match Chun-Li’s muscular physique.

articles.title: Blizzard Workers Win Historic Union Contract That Could Set A New Standard For Game Developers
articles.summary: A group of 1,900 employees at Blizzard Entertainment has successfully signed a union contract with Microsoft, securing several guarantees for members. Represented by the Communications Workers of America (CWA), the contract has given the Blizzard workers more workplace flexibility and guaranteed…
body: One of the big wins for the Blizzard union is artificial intelligence guardrails, as the contract stipulates that Microsoft cannot use AI to automate or replace jobs without first talking to the union. Another big win are the job-recall rights for employees, because if they're laid off, Blizzard must offer them an open role within 14 months and inside the union's network before hiring someone from outside. Laid-off union members will also get an additional four weeks of pay--regardless of how long they worked at the company--hybrid schedules that allow them to work from home, and formal systems to settle disputes within the workplace.

"It's a new day at Blizzard, where greater power for workers is translating into more innovative games for players," CWA president Claude Cummings, Jr. said to Game Developer. "I am so proud of CWA bargaining teams, taking on tough fights and winning strong contracts that set new standards for working people across our industries."

articles.title: Switch 2’s 40th-Anniversary Console Sells Out Immediately, And Guess What Happened Next
articles.summary: Nintendo's new 40th-anniversary Zelda-themed Switch 2 console went on sale on September 8, the same day it was announced, and it sold out immediately. I bet you can guess what happened next.
body: I bet you can guess what happened next. Listings for the $520 limited-edition console popped up on eBay the same day, with sellers hoping to make tidy profits. There are numerous listings on eBay asking for $800 and $850 --that's about 50% more than the list price. It appears there is a single seller account offering five different units, so this is very clearly a scalping scenario, and it may run afoul of eBay's own rules.
This kind of thing is pretty normal, as people are known to take advantage of a limited-edition product to make some money on the demand.

The Zelda console releases on October 29 as part of Nintendo's celebration of the franchise's 40th anniversary. The console sports a spiffy black-and-gold design, featuring the Triforce design as well. Nintendo is also selling anniversary editions of the Switch 2 Pro controller and a Switch 2 carrying case, both of which also feature the Triforce design. The Pro controller ($100) also sold out.
The Switch 2 Zelda system has been described as being a limited-edition, so it remains to be seen if Nintendo will replenish stock soon, or ever.

articles.title: Apple Announces the iPhone 18 Pro
articles.summary: Apple has just announced the iPhone 18 Pro at its 'Surprise and Shine' September event. While last year's iPhone 17 Pro Max had a new chassis, with an improved camera shelf and a new vapor chamber, the iPhone 18 Pro has largely adopted the same design.
body: Apple led the announcement touting the capabilities of Siri AI, showing things like email construction, system dictation, and camera integration, letting you ask questions about stuff you see in the wild, or pulling event details from a flyer and adding them to your calendar.

Apple says the iPhone 18 Pro uses a new vapor chamber for improved thermals. The battery is expected to match the iPhone 17 Pro Max – approximately 36 hours of video playback – while the iPhone 18 Pro Max will be capable of up to 45 hours. Apple claims that 5 minutes of charging will get you 6 hours of video playback.

Apple also discussed the phone's new camera capabilities. The iPhone 18 Pro has a new 48MP main camera featuring a physical shutter, which means that you can adjust the aperture manually beyond what's capable in software effects. In particular, this should make the camera excellent for shooting in low light settings.

articles.title: With No 3D Mario In Sight, Mario’s 40th Is A Bust For Switch 2 Owners
articles.summary: Another Nintendo Direct came and went without mention of a new Mario game, ending the franchise's 40th anniversary year not with a bang, but with a resounding "huh?" Despite rumors and murmurs from noted leakers, there was no reveal of a 3D Mario game at the September 2026 Nintendo Direct.
body: Meanwhile, there hasn't even been a hint of a 3D Mario game for Switch 2. At the very least, Mario fans have been able to enjoy Donkey Kong Bananza, which was developed by the same team that made Super Mario Odyssey--and it certainly has a lot of Odyssey's DNA. Still, the lack of a mainline Mario game puts a damper on a monumental anniversary year for the jump-happy plumber.

Yes, Mario hit it big at the box office with The Super Mario Galaxy Movie, but all Switch 2 owners have gotten are ports and a tennis game. And while Nintendo counted the adorable Yoshi and the Mysterious Book as part of the celebration, that game is notably Mario-less.

articles.title: The Duskbloods Was A No-Show At The September Nintendo Direct And Now I’m Worried
articles.summary: The Duskbloods, From Software's new game and one of the Switch 2's biggest exclusives, was missing-in-action during the September Nintendo Direct. That normally wouldn't be too shocking, except for the fact The Duskbloods is still slated to release this year.
body: One might have assumed the next game from the creators of Elden Ring would receive a release date as part of the presentation, as well as perhaps a glimpse at some of the maps and playable characters not featured in a recent The Duskbloods closed network test. The fact it wasn't shown or mentioned at all is more than a little worrying.

The closed network test for The Duskbloods in August didn't exactly go as planned, with From Software actually cancelling the first day of sessions due to technical difficulties and server issues. Its problems were later resolved for the playtests' subsequent days, allowing players to jump in and take a stab at The Duskbloods' unique blend of cooperative and competitive soulsborne action. It wouldn't be surprising if, given the network test, From Software realized it needed more time to iron out The Duskbloods online multiplayer kinks.

articles.title: Valheim 1.0's Steam player count soars to a huge 5-year high, but it's not enough to beat the viral survival game's early access peak
articles.summary: The five-year wait for Valheim 1.0 doesn't seem to have hurt the survival game behemoth's popularity all that much. After leaving early access, the crafty viking sim is enjoying a huge resurgence in Steam player numbers.
body: Still, Valheim hasn't been able to capture lightning in a bottle twice. At least, not yet. The game peaked over five years ago when 502,387 people logged on at the same time, aided by memes that sailed across the web and a playerbase that wasn't totally pandemic-free yet.

Today's Steam stats may also be skewed by the fact that Iron Gate's breakout game is now available to play on PS5, Nintendo Switch 2 and Xbox Series X/S consoles. The Valheim crowd on Steam no longer represents the entire Valheim crowd, then. We'll see how high those numbers soar as the game heads into its first proper weekend of release.

The Valheim 1.0 update arguably matches the game's incredible launch stats, too. Iron Gate's new patch notes are almost 1,800 words long and include too much new newness for me to neatly summarise here. Long story short, if you've not touched the procgen afterlife in a while, Valheim 1.0 adds a new biome called Deep North, over 40 fresh weapons, lots of new bits and bobs and hammers to craft, a graphics setting to stretch draw distances, and much more.

articles.title: Beloved Fantasy Book Series Redfall Officially Returns in 2027
articles.summary: For 25 years from 1986 to 2011, writer Brian Jacques stole the hearts of readers everywhere with his Redwall series of fantasy novels. The Rogue Crew was released in 2011, three months after Jacques' death, and for 15 years it has remained the final entry in the series — until now.
body: As spotted by the Redwall fan wiki, a 23rd book in the series has been announced, and it's coming next year. The book, titled Orphans of Mossflower, will be released on Sept. 7, 2027, alongside a new boxed set containing the other 22 novels in the series. Both coincide with the 40th anniversary of the series, which was first published in the U.K. in 1986 and in the United States a year later. While details are sparse, Orphans of Mossflower is being advertised as being written by Jacques.

Fans have suspected a 23rd book in the series existed in some form for over a decade. In 2010, publisher Penguin held a contest that let one lucky fan name a character in the next Redwall novel. The winner came forward in 2015 with details on the character, and fans realized they did not appear in The Rogue Crew, fueling the theory that another book existed.

articles.title: Almost 1,900 Blizzard workers vote through a "historic" union contract securing protections against layoffs and gen-AI
articles.summary: Around 1,900 unionised workers at Blizzard Entertainment have voted to ratify their first contract with the World of Warcraft publisher after years of negotiations. The union contract means Blizzard now has to bargain with staff over the use of generative-AI in game development, and workers also…
body: The contract covers all union-represented staff across the World of Warcraft, Warcraft Rumble, Hearthstone, Overwatch and Diablo teams, as well as people from Blizzard's QA, Platform and Technology, and Story and Franchise Development units. Some rare good news in the gaming world!

The Communications Workers of America labor union called the new contract "historic" in a recent press release and explained that Blizzard is now required to "discuss, evaluate, and bargain over the usage of artificial intelligence in the workplace." In a first for the video game industry, the contract has also given staff "the right to be 'recalled' into open positions across any Blizzard bargaining unit for 14 months from the date of their layoff announcement." Union members secured an extra four weeks of severance as part of the negotiations, as well, in the event of any layoffs.

articles.title: Kirby and the World Beyond coming to Nintendo Switch 2 in Spring 2027
articles.summary: Sounds the alarms! A reveal trailer for a brand-new Kirby game has been revealed in today's Nintendo Direct. Called Kirby and the World Beyond, the game is headed to the Nintendo Switch 2 in Spring, 2027.
body: The game has a very vibrant, colourful aesthetic as is the norm with the Kirby series. Kirby is seen running through luscious green pastures, leaping across logs and other rushing across bridges. You can suck up enemies, of course, providing Kirby new abilities that come in handy during combat and open world traversal. Check out the trailer below.

Kirby's Sword Copy ability also be seen - a long-running with Kirby charging around with the Master Sword and using it to quickly ascend vertically. King Dedede is also present as a boss, who Kirby knocks through a Truman Show-style wall in the horizon. How mysterious!

On the topic of Zelda, that Link power up receives a massive power up in the second half of the trailer. In what appears to be a Tears of the Kingdom -specific modifier, Kirby can use his buffed-up Master Sword-looking upgrade to chop down trees and open up new pathways. Kirby also used it to break out into a very Hyrule-looking environment beyond the bounds of the vivid world they know. What is waiting for Kirby out there remains to be seen - the next world over does look very, very Zelda-inspired from here, though.

Called Kirby and the World Beyond, the game is headed to the Nintendo Switch 2 in Spring, 2027.
